name: 凝岳沉目
prompt: Edit ONLY the isolated compact male eyes of reference 1 into another original compact eye variant. Keep the eyes' short horizontal width, normal iris/pupil diameter and moderate vertical opening EXACTLY as in reference 1. Keep pupil spacing wide and preserve the source canvas positions. The complete painted eye width including lashes must remain about HALF the centre-to-centre pupil distance. Do not reduce pupil spacing. Reference 2 (our portrait face) is only the painting style master. Only change the lid silhouette a little: a subtly lifted short outer canthus, slightly gentler more angular upper arc, shallow lower arc, composed confident male gaze. Short rounded inner corner, natural short outer corner; no horizontal elongation, NO long pointed wing, no eye-liner tail. Do not make eyes bigger or taller, do not enlarge iris, do not draw big doll eyes. Keep natural short eyelashes and the refined smooth warm charcoal ink-wash shading, muted taupe-brown irises, modest warm off-white sclera and matching tiny soft pupil highlights. Matte painterly pigment with fine details, no thick black vector edges, no grainy sketch, no exaggerated lashes. Remove surrounding opaque skin, retain only the organs, lid ink and faint translucent crease. NO eyebrows, hair, face, head or nose. ONE symmetrical horizontal eye pair, strictly forward view, truly transparent background and clean margins.

name: 长风清目
prompt:
Edit ONLY the eye pair in reference 1. Reference 2 is our game's face and is ONLY the painting style and facial-scale reference. User correction: each individual eye is horizontally TOO LONG. Repaint BOTH eyes into COMPACT adult male eyes. Shorten the actual eye aperture at BOTH the inner and outer ends towards its pupil, and remove the drawn-out outer-corner wing. Do NOT merely erase a lash tip while retaining an elongated eye. Preserve the centres and centre-to-centre spacing of the two pupils from reference 1; preserve the iris diameter, pupil diameter and vertical eye opening. Preserve vertical lid anatomy and natural short lashes. Do NOT scale down the whole pair or squish it horizontally. Shorten the painted anatomy itself, using shorter canthal reach, a softly rounded inner corner and a short natural outer corner with no eyeliner tail. Result must be distinctly less elongated, still appropriately open, never narrow slits or tiny eyes. Match our first-style finely painted warm charcoal ink edges, delicate smooth ink-wash tonal gradation, muted taupe-grey-brown irises, restrained off-white sclera, matte light and small symmetrical iris highlights. Preserve fine upper and a few lower natural eyelashes, not thick makeup. Return ONE isolated symmetrical level front-view eye pair on genuinely transparent background. ONLY eye organs, lids and faint translucent crease pigment; no eyebrows, no hair, no face, nose or opaque surrounding skin patches. No vector outlines, coarse grain, sharp triangular corners or anime. For this version, shorten each eye's total painted horizontal length by roughly 10–12 percent. Preserve its slightly rounder central arch and rounded lower lid with the same healthy vertical opening, keep the male proportions and normal iris size. No exaggerated long lash wing.
Composition requirement: keep a generous transparent gap between eyes. The pupil centre spacing should be at least 1.8 times each eye's complete painted width including short lashes; compact eye width must be no more than 0.55 of the pupil spacing. Keep aperture height and normal iris diameter; do not reduce pupil spacing when shortening the eye.
